_comment: Away-mode webhook template. Copy to ~/.claude/jarvis-webhook.json (or point at it with
`/jarvis webhook <path>`). When `/jarvis away on` is set, JARVIS synthesizes the summary,
converts it to `audio_format`, and fires THIS request with the placeholders filled in.
Placeholders you can use anywhere in url/headers/body:
{{audio_base64}}  base64 of the audio (use this for WhatsApp PTT)
{{text}}          the spoken summary (nice as a caption)
{{audio_path}}    on-disk path (only for multipart uploads: set "multipart": true
and give a field the value "@{{audio_path}}")
${ENV_VAR}        any env var; load secrets via "secrets_env" below
This example sends a real WhatsApp voice message (PTT) via the same endpoint
JARVIS already works with. Set JARVIS_WPP_PHONE in the secrets_env file.
